title: Groom Club Monthly Cancellation Settlement Schedule — Tailwise Grooming Salon
content:
**Settlement schedule — Groom Club Monthly, Tailwise Grooming Salon.**

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Billed month | a monthly fee charged on the club after the month of joining |
| Early termination fee in the settlement | the club's early termination fee when the club has fewer billed months than the club's minimum term; nothing otherwise |
| Club late-cancellation charges in the settlement | every club late-cancellation charge booked on the club |
| Settlement | the early termination fee part plus the club late-cancellation charges, rounded half up to the cent once on the final amount |

Stated as a clause: a billed month is a monthly fee charged on the club after the month of joining; the club cancellation settlement is the club's early termination fee when the club has fewer than its minimum term of billed months and nothing otherwise, plus every club late-cancellation charge booked on the club, rounded half up to the cent once on the final amount.

The early termination fee and the minimum term are those on the Groom Club Monthly membership terms schedule. The billed months and the club late-cancellation charge entries are read from the salon history of the club; the first fee, charged when the club was joined, is not a billed month.

**Rounding.** Half up means a figure lying exactly on a half cent goes to the higher cent; a tolerance of 0.0001 cent is added to the final amount before it is rounded.

**Worked settlements (hypothetical clubs; schedule figures of a 25.00 early termination fee and a 3-month minimum term)**

| Billed months | Club late-cancellation charges booked | Settlement |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | none | 25.00 |
| 2 | one charge of 43.99 | 25.00 plus 43.99, that is 68.99 |
| 3 | none | 0.00 |
| 5 | one charge of 21.99 | 21.99 |
